moves.name: Roman Wilson
moves.text: Drop candidate: Roman Wilson (PIT WR) - RotoWire: "Expected to miss time" (Oct 11); out Weeks 6-9, back about Week 10 (Week 9 is his bye); ~9.6 a game when healthy. No IR slot is left, so holding him costs a roster seat while he is out. The cheapest other bench seat to free instead: George Holani (SEA RB), worth ~7 pts to the best lineup through Week 17. Dom's call - never an order.

moves.name: David Montgomery
moves.text: Hold David Montgomery (HOU RB) - RotoWire: "week-to-week" (Oct 12); out Weeks 6-8, back about Week 9 (Week 8 is his bye); ~9.3 a game when healthy. Once back he is worth ~15 pts to the best lineup through Week 17, more than the cheapest other bench seat, George Holani (SEA RB, ~7 pts). If a roster seat is needed while he is out, free that one instead. Dom's call - never an order.
